parts: Production cutout parts sheet for CAPIMANSA, the capybara living-kite in reference 1, matching approved Carcara handmade flat folded-paper finish in reference 2. Preserve capybara identity unmistakably: broad blunt rectangular dark brown muzzle, tiny high rounded ears, small calm dark eyes, warm ochre/caramel squat barrel body, four SHORT stocky dark feet. NOT bear, dog, guinea pig, fox. THREE QUARTER RIGHT facing, near face and smaller far eye visible, calm patient companion. Integrated deep TEAL and IVORY triangular patchwork kite sail rising from the back, structural bamboo spars tied with cords, tiny stitched paper repairs, two hanging green leaf ties. Teal/ivory folded paper ribbon tail attached rear, sweeping left. The animal itself consists of simple large folded-paper planes, dark ink outlines and restrained 2-3 flat tones per material, no realistic fur, no shiny 3D, no gradients, no huge cute eyes or white sparkle. Original has warm paper body and contrasting teal sail; retain that balance. Sheet portrait THREE COLUMNS FOUR ROWS, transparent background, generous space between all pieces, no labels or text or ground shadows. Row1 col1 torso ONLY (capybara barrel body without head or legs), col2 full neutral capybara head with ears, blunt nose and short neck, col3 full bamboo teal/ivory sail with leaves rooted at lower-right. Row2 col1 near front short leg, root top-left and dark foot down-right; col2 smaller far front leg; col3 complete short angular teal/ivory ribbon tail, root upper-right, curve left and down. Row3 col1 near hind short leg root top-right; col2 smaller far hind leg; col3 determined expression head. Row4 col1 hurt head squeezed eyes, col2 happy head relaxed closed eyes, col3 EMPTY. Expression heads exactly same silhouette, muzzle, ears, size, pose and colors as neutral; ONLY eyes/brows change, nose/mouth stay identical. All eight anatomy pieces fully separated with complete covered roots for animation, no holes at attachment, no clipping or touching. Do not make front legs into long arms. Make beautiful coherent original game art consistent with approved handmade living-kite family.
